newsitem.title: USA: MGE spring wheat off lows on commercial buying.
newsitem.headline: MGE spring wheat off lows on commercial buying.

text.p: MGE spring wheat futures were lifted off their early lows on commercial buying of the March contract, traders said.
"We opened under pressure because of producers selling... but right after we got down to our lows we saw Continental come in and buy around 1.5 million March," a MGE trader said.
Traders also said Benson-Quinn and Atwood/Peavey each bull-spread at least 500,000 Dec/March bushels, which brought the traded spread from 11 cents out to 12 cents.
At 1018 CDT, spring wheat was 1-1/2 to 2-1/2 cents per bushel lower, with Dec down 1-1/2 cents at $4.07-1/2.
Traders said Wilson bear-spread one million March/Dec at 10 to 11 cents.
Volumes were said to have been moderate in the opening 30 minutes of the session but had since eased up.
